id: Hearthome City Pokémon Gym Leader:\nFantina
en: Hearthome City Pokémon Gym Leader:\nFantina
it: Capopalestra della Palestra Pokémon di Cuoripoli:\nFannie

id: The Alluring, Soulful Dancer!
en: The Alluring, Soulful Dancer!
it: L'affascinante ballerina dall'animo intenso!

id: \bWelcome!
en: \bWelcome!
it: \bBenvenuto!

id: \bExploud
en: \bExploud
it: \bExploud

id: \bI can predict your future. Want to hear it?
en: \bI can predict your future. Want to hear it?
it: \bPosso predire il tuo futuro. Vuoi sentirlo?

id: \bI foresee that you will not enter this route today.
en: \bI foresee that you will not enter this route today.
it: \bPrevedo che oggi non entrerai in questo percorso.

id: \bSee, told you. Now go away so this premonition comes true.
en: \bSee, told you. Now go away so this premonition comes true.
it: \bVisto? Te l'avevo detto. Ora vattene, così questa premonizione si avvera.

id: \bFine. Leave me be then.
en: \bFine. Leave me be then.
it: \bE va bene. Allora lasciami in pace.

id: \bChimchar?
en: \bChimchar?
it: \bChimchar?

id: Would you like to take Chimchar with you?
en: Would you like to take Chimchar with you?
it: Vuoi portare Chimchar con te?

id: \bChar...
en: \bChar...
it: \bChar...

id: Chimchar walked off for the forest...
en: Chimchar walked off for the forest...
it: Chimchar si è allontanato verso la foresta...

id: \bPaul: Good riddance Chimchar. You're just too weak.
en: \bPaul: Good riddance Chimchar. You're just too weak.
it: \bPaul: Finalmente me ne sono liberato, Chimchar. Sei semplicemente troppo debole.

id: \bChimchar!!
en: \bChimchar!!
it: \bChimchar!!

id: \bWhat? You think it's wrong of me to release it? What do I care?
en: \bWhat? You think it's wrong of me to release it?  What do I care?
it: \bChe c'è? Pensi che sia sbagliato liberarlo?  E a me che importa?

id: \bIt was a pathetic excuse of a Pokémon that I entertained for far too long.
en: \bIt was a pathetic excuse of a Pokémon that I entertained for far too long.
it: \bEra un Pokémon patetico che mi sono tenuto fin troppo a lungo.

id: \bDon't be late to our next battle.
en: \bDon't be late to our next battle.
it: \bNon fare tardi alla nostra prossima lotta.

id: \bEspeon
en: \bEspeon
it: \bEspeon

id: Hearthome City\nWarm & Kind
en: Hearthome City\nWarm & Kind
it: Cuoripoli\nCalda e gentile

id: \bThe Gym Leader is currently away.
en: \bThe Gym Leader is currently away.
it: \bIl Capopalestra al momento è assente.

id: \rDawn: Hi \PN. I figured you would be coming here. The Gym Leader is still away, but I heard she was heading to Celestic Town.
en: \rDawn: Hi \PN. I figured you would be coming here.  The Gym Leader is still away, but I heard she was heading to Celestic Town.
it: \rLucinda: Ciao \PN. Immaginavo che saresti venuto qui.  La Capopalestra è ancora via, ma ho sentito che era diretta a Memoride.

id: \rI was heading there myself and figured you might have wanted to know about the Gym Leader.
en: \rI was heading there myself and figured you might have wanted to know about the Gym Leader.
it: \rAnch'io stavo andando lì e ho pensato che ti avrebbe fatto piacere sapere della Capopalestra.

id: \rNow that you came, check out my contest moves. I've been practicing really hard.
en: \rNow that you came, check out my contest moves.  I've been practicing really hard.
it: \rOra che sei qui, guarda le mie mosse da gara.  Mi sono allenata tantissimo.

id: \rWow. I still have a long way to go.
en: \rWow. I still have a long way to go.
it: \rWow. Ho ancora tanta strada da fare.

id: \rOh right I have something to give you. Have you seen the Psyduck on Route 210? They won't move for anything. Try giving them this.
en: \rOh right I have something to give you. Have you seen the Psyduck on Route 210? They won't move for anything. Try giving them this.
it: \rAh, giusto, ho una cosa da darti. Hai visto gli Psyduck sul Percorso 210? Non si spostano per nessun motivo. Prova a dargli questa.

id: \rDawn: The Secret Potion should cure them of their headaches. Give it a try.
en: \rDawn: The Secret Potion should cure them of their headaches. Give it a try.
it: \rLucinda: La Pozione Segreta dovrebbe curargli il mal di testa. Provaci.

id: \bBarry: I can't believe I lost!!! Fantina is so so strong it's unbelievable!!
en: \bBarry: I can't believe I lost!!! Fantina is so so strong it's unbelievable!!
it: \bBarry: Non ci credo che ho perso!!! Fannie è così forte che è incredibile!!

id: \bWho are you? Did you plan on challenging the Gym? I'm the upcoming Pokémon Champion, Barry!
en: \bWho are you? Did you plan on challenging the Gym? I'm the upcoming Pokémon Champion, Barry!
it: \bE tu chi sei? Volevi sfidare la Palestra? Io sono il futuro Campione Pokémon, Barry!

id: \bYou look familiar...\nOh right, you're the guy that battled alongside Paul in the Hearthome City Tag Battle Competition.
en: \bYou look familiar...\nOh right, you're the guy that battled alongside Paul in the Hearthome City Tag Battle Competition.
it: \bHai un'aria familiare...\nAh già, sei quello che ha lottato insieme a Paul alla Gara di Lotte in Coppia di Cuoripoli.

id: \bYou're a lot weaker than him, so there is no way you'll beat this Gym. I'll be your opponent to see if you deserve it.
en: \bYou're a lot weaker than him, so there is no way you'll beat this Gym. I'll be your opponent to see if you deserve it.
it: \bSei molto più debole di lui, quindi non c'è modo che tu batta questa Palestra. Ti sfiderò io per vedere se te lo meriti.

id: \bBarry: I lost!? How could that possibly happen?? I demand compensation. A million dollar fine will do.
en: \bBarry: I lost!? How could that possibly happen?? I demand compensation. A million dollar fine will do.
it: \bBarry: Ho perso!? Com'è possibile che sia successo?? Pretendo un risarcimento. Una multa da un milione andrà benissimo.

id: \bWait! I forgot all about the Honey Tree I set up! I need to go check it. We'll finish this later \PN.
en: \bWait! I forgot all about the Honey Tree I set up! I need to go check it. We'll finish this later \PN.
it: \bAspetta! Mi sono completamente scordato dell'albero col miele che ho preparato! Devo andare a controllarlo. La finiamo dopo, \PN.

id: \rKanga
en: \rKanga
it: \rKanga

id: \bEvery now and then the Battle Hall opens up for Trainers to test themselves.
en: \bEvery now and then the Battle Hall opens up for Trainers to test themselves.
it: \bOgni tanto il Sala Lotta apre le porte agli Allenatori che vogliono mettersi alla prova.

id: \bHey, have you seen the Battle Hall? You should go check it out.
en: \bHey, have you seen the Battle Hall? You should go check it out.
it: \bEhi, hai visto il Sala Lotta? Dovresti andare a darci un'occhiata.

id: \bWoah. You won the Battle Hall.
en: \bWoah. You won the Battle Hall.
it: \bWow. Hai vinto al Sala Lotta.

id: \rPachi
en: \rPachi
it: \rPachi

id: \bWhat am I doing here?
en: \bWhat am I doing here?
it: \bChe ci faccio qui?

id: \rHello. The cave ahead is dangerous.
en: \rHello. The cave ahead is dangerous.
it: \rCiao. La grotta più avanti è pericolosa.

id: \rHello. The cave is dangerous so I'm using my Abra to teleport people past it. Want to be teleported to Route 207?
en: \rHello. The cave is dangerous so I'm using my Abra to teleport people past it. Want to be teleported to Route 207?
it: \rCiao. La grotta è pericolosa, quindi uso il mio Abra per teletrasportare la gente oltre. Vuoi essere teletrasportato al Percorso 207?

id: \rOkay, but I'm still not letting you in.
en: \rOkay, but I'm still not letting you in.
it: \rVa bene, ma comunque non ti faccio entrare.

id: \rHello. The cave is dangerous so I'm using my Abra to teleport people past it. You seem really strong though.
en: \rHello. The cave is dangerous so I'm using my Abra to teleport people past it. You seem really strong though.
it: \rCiao. La grotta è pericolosa, quindi uso il mio Abra per teletrasportare la gente oltre. Però sembri davvero forte.
